classification.difficultyReason: Use tangent to find the left base segment, subtract it from the total base, then apply Pythagoras to the right triangle; the main decision is connecting the two triangles through the remaining base segment.

content.prompt: Find the length $x$ in the diagram below, correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: A base of total length 28, left base angle 30 degrees, interior perpendicular altitude 15, and unknown right sloping side x. External dimension arrows retain the source associations.
spec.mathematics: Altitude foot is 15 sqrt(3) from the left endpoint; x is the hypotenuse of the remaining right triangle. Coordinates implement the givens; the near-vertical right edge is mathematically necessary even though the source sketch exaggerates its horizontal run.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the printed givens and x are visible.

answer.worked:
Let $d$ be the horizontal distance from the left vertex to the foot of the altitude.
$$\begin{align*}\tan30^\circ&=\frac{15}{d}\\d&=\frac{15}{\tan30^\circ}\\d&=15\sqrt3\\x^2&=15^2+(28-15\sqrt3)^2\\x&=\sqrt{225+(28-15\sqrt3)^2}\\x&\approx15.14\end{align*}$$
